notes.title: Tutorial bug fix
notes.notes: A player found that they couldn't get through the tutorial if they picked the Mammal a second time. All fixed now!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey gang! We're spread REALLY thin right now, but we have a little update to tide you over with some bug fixes until the next major update which is still underway.


 Softlock from endless mode fixed
 Fullscreen mode is available from the options menu
 The long awaited "Cool mode" will finally be available. Press F in battle.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey gang, Disco Reptile here. Some lovely players gave us some feedback we had a few changes to make!

Bug fixes:

 Inspection button should no longer remain on the map screen.
 V now maxes out at 99.
 Fixed a visual bug with "ally" and "enemy" being shown in the inventory.
 The X button to end a boss battle you weren't ready for was overstaying its welcome, and remaining past beating the actual bosses. Fixed that.
 Added a little tutorial message explaining the box, since some players seemed to think the box keeping its beastie between saves was unintentional.
 The X button to end a boss stayed after the battle begun, meaning you could leave at any point and not lose a heart.
 Fixed a few typos on the journal.
 A few difficulty tweaks.
 Items now randomize when you beat a boss, not just when you start the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hey gang! Disco Reptile here. The boss let me know of a few bugs people had found, so I took the opportunity to sprinkle some quality of life features in based on recent feedback.

1.1.0
Features:

 Spacial box! Once your party is full, you can put an itemless beastie into the box. It will stay there even after you start a new game, so you can take strong beasties from it. It appears in the bottom left hand corner of the map once you have a full party after The Big Tree... assuming it isn't full while your party's full as well.
 You can now leave boss fights.
 When you fail a puzzle, the game will now advance instead of forcing you to solve it. You won't get the rewards, but you won't be stuck. Don't worry, it'll still be there on your next run, and you can try again by hitting the restart button as usual.


Bug fixes:

 Some players found that Luna's buff was permanent, which was either a blessing or a curse. It now functions as intended.
 If you have no beasties and no food, you'll get food. Some players seemed to be starting the game without either somehow. This seemed like the best solution.


Thanks for playing!!
